name: color-galaxy-color-data
title: Color Galaxy color data
description: 31,996 named colors with codes in RGB, HSL, HSV, CMYK, CIE XYZ, Yxy, Hunter Lab, CIE Lab and LCh, CSS and web-safe equivalents, accessibility contrast, color groupings, shades, tints and palettes, and chart layouts (spiral galaxy, Milky Way ribbon and hue-by-saturation color picker) for all colors and four color sets.

sources.title: meodai/color-names v14.80.0 (MIT License, (c) David Aerne and contributors)
sources.description: Color names and hex values: the full list (https://unpkg.com/color-name-list/dist/colornames.csv, 31,993 colors) and its hand-picked best-of list (https://unpkg.com/color-name-list/dist/colornames.bestof.csv). The list merges names from CSS, xkcd, Wikipedia, Crayola, ntc.js and community submissions.

sources.title: W3C CSS Color Module Level 4, named colors
sources.description: The 148 CSS color keywords (139 distinct colors): is_css_named, css_keywords, css_name. Three of them (olive, darkgray, goldenrod) are not in meodai/color-names and are added as their own rows.

sources.title: W3Schools HTML color groups
sources.description: Group label of each CSS color (css_group), and the reference used to tune the calculated shade_group.

sources.title: color-hex.com
sources.description: Reference for the shade, tint, RGB-share and CMYK formulas, checked against its color pages. No data is copied from it.

resources.name: colors
resources.title: Colors
resources.description: One row per named color: names, codes in every color model, groupings, picker boxes and related colors.

fields.name: color_id
fields.description: Unique id 1-31,996, in name A-Z order (accents folded, case ignored, ties by hex). Primary key; joins every file.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Color name. The 139 official HTML/CSS colors use their CSS name (e.g. Wheat); all others use the meodai/color-names name. Not unique (some CSS names also exist in meodai at another hex): key on color_id or hex.

fields.name: meodai_name
fields.description: Name as published by meodai/color-names. Differs from name for CSS colors renamed to their CSS name; blank for the 3 CSS-only colors.

fields.name: hex
fields.description: Hex color, #rrggbb, lowercase. Unique.

fields.name: hex_code
fields.description: Hex color without #, uppercase (RRGGBB). Unique.

fields.name: is_css_named
fields.description: 1 if the color is an official CSS/HTML named color, else 0.

fields.name: css_keywords
fields.description: CSS keyword(s) for this hex, separated by '; ' (e.g. 'aqua; cyan'); blank if not a CSS color.

fields.name: css_name
fields.description: CSS display name in CamelCase (gray spelling preferred over grey); blank if not a CSS color.

fields.name: css_group
fields.description: W3Schools color group of the CSS color; blank if not a CSS color.

fields.name: r
fields.description: Red channel, 0-255.

fields.name: g
fields.description: Green channel, 0-255.

fields.name: b
fields.description: Blue channel, 0-255.

fields.name: rgb_share_r
fields.description: Red share of R+G+B, % (the 'RGB %' shown on color-hex.com); 0 for black.

fields.name: rgb_share_g
fields.description: Green share of R+G+B, %; 0 for black.

fields.name: rgb_share_b
fields.description: Blue share of R+G+B, %; 0 for black.

fields.name: rgb_pct_r
fields.description: Red as % of 255.

fields.name: rgb_pct_g
fields.description: Green as % of 255.

fields.name: rgb_pct_b
fields.description: Blue as % of 255.

fields.name: hsl_h
fields.description: HSL hue, degrees 0-360.

fields.name: hsl_s
fields.description: HSL saturation, %.

fields.name: hsl_l
fields.description: HSL lightness, %.

fields.name: hsv_h
fields.description: HSV hue, degrees 0-360 (same as hsl_h).

fields.name: hsv_s
fields.description: HSV saturation, %.

fields.name: hsv_v
fields.description: HSV value (brightness), %.

fields.name: cmyk_c
fields.description: Cyan, % (device-independent formula: K = 1 - max(R,G,B)/255, C = (1 - R/255 - K) / (1 - K)).

fields.name: cmyk_m
fields.description: Magenta, %.

fields.name: cmyk_y
fields.description: Yellow, %.

fields.name: cmyk_k
fields.description: Key (black), %.

fields.name: xyz_x
fields.description: CIE XYZ X (D65, 0-100).

fields.name: xyz_y
fields.description: CIE XYZ Y (luminance, 0-100).

fields.name: xyz_z
fields.description: CIE XYZ Z (D65).

fields.name: yxy_Y
fields.description: CIE Yxy luminance Y (same as xyz_y).

fields.name: yxy_x
fields.description: CIE xy chromaticity x = X / (X+Y+Z); 0 for black.

fields.name: yxy_y
fields.description: CIE xy chromaticity y = Y / (X+Y+Z); 0 for black.

fields.name: hunter_l
fields.description: Hunter Lab L.

fields.name: hunter_a
fields.description: Hunter Lab a (red +, green -).

fields.name: hunter_b
fields.description: Hunter Lab b (yellow +, blue -).

fields.name: lab_l
fields.description: CIE L* lightness, 0-100 (D65).

fields.name: lab_a
fields.description: CIE a* (red +, green -).

fields.name: lab_b
fields.description: CIE b* (yellow +, blue -).

fields.name: lch_c
fields.description: CIE LCh chroma C*: colorfulness, 0 for grays.

fields.name: lch_h
fields.description: CIE LCh hue angle, degrees 0-360.

fields.name: web_safe_hex
fields.description: Nearest of the 216 web-safe colors (each channel rounded to a multiple of 51).

fields.name: is_web_safe
fields.description: 1 if the color is itself web-safe, else 0.

fields.name: dominant_channel
fields.description: Largest RGB channel; ties are joined with '/' (e.g. 'Red/Green'); 'Neutral' when R = G = B.

fields.name: relative_luminance
fields.description: WCAG relative luminance, 0 (black) to 1 (white).

fields.name: contrast_vs_white
fields.description: WCAG contrast ratio against white text, 1-21.

fields.name: contrast_vs_black
fields.description: WCAG contrast ratio against black text, 1-21.

fields.name: best_text_color
fields.description: White or Black, whichever has the higher contrast on this color.

fields.name: css_rgb
fields.description: Ready-to-paste CSS value, e.g. rgb(255, 99, 71).

fields.name: css_hsl
fields.description: Ready-to-paste CSS value, e.g. hsl(9, 100%, 64%) (rounded).

fields.name: shade_group
fields.description: Basic color family from CIE L* and C*, HSL hue and HSV value. C* under 8: White (L* 93+), Black (L* under 12) or Gray. Very pale tints are White, faintly tinted mid and dark colors (C* under 13, L* under 80) are Gray. The rest go by hue, with browns split from oranges, yellows and muted reds by brightness and chroma, and pinks from reds by lightness. A calculated rule, not a human label: it agrees with W3Schools' groups for 122 of 141 CSS colors.

fields.name: hue_family
fields.description: 12-step color wheel (30-degree slices of HSL hue, Red centered on 0), or Neutral when chroma is under 8.

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: Warm (hue under 80 or from 330), Cool, or Neutral (chroma under 8).

fields.name: lightness_band
fields.description: Dark (L* under 35), Medium (35-70) or Light (70 and up).

fields.name: saturation_band
fields.description: Muted (C* under 20), Moderate (20-50) or Vivid (50 and up).

fields.name: style
fields.description: First matching rule: Neutral (C* < 8); Neon (HSV saturation >= 85%, value >= 90%, C* >= 70); Pastel (L* >= 78, C* < 40); Earth Tone (hue 15-100, L* 20-70, C* 10-50); Jewel Tone (L* 20-55, C* >= 45); Dark (L* < 20); Muted (C* < 30); otherwise Bright.

fields.name: nearest_css_name
fields.description: Closest CSS named color by OKLab distance (the color itself for CSS colors).

fields.name: nearest_css_group
fields.description: W3Schools group of nearest_css_name.

fields.name: picker_cell_id
fields.description: Cell of a 36 x 20 hue-by-saturation grid (10 degrees of hue by 5 points of HSV saturation), numbered 1-720 in reading order from the top-left (full color on top, white at the bottom). Pure grays fall in the bottom-left cell.

fields.name: picker_box_col
fields.description: Full picker box column, 1-108 (3 per 10-degree hue column), left to right through the hues. Colors are spread evenly inside their hue column, so this is a rank, not an exact hue.

fields.name: picker_box_row
fields.description: Full picker box row, 1-60, from white (1) to full color (60), by saturation rank inside the column; pure grays sit along row 1.

fields.name: picker_box_top
fields.description: 1 on the one color each of the 6,480 boxes shows (its brightest), else 0. Filter to 1 to draw the box picker.

fields.name: shade_1
fields.description: Shade 1: the color mixed 10% toward black (each channel floor(v x 0.9)).

fields.name: shade_2
fields.description: Shade 2: the color mixed 20% toward black (each channel floor(v x 0.8)).

fields.name: shade_3
fields.description: Shade 3: the color mixed 30% toward black (each channel floor(v x 0.7)).

fields.name: shade_4
fields.description: Shade 4: the color mixed 40% toward black (each channel floor(v x 0.6)).

fields.name: shade_5
fields.description: Shade 5: the color mixed 50% toward black (each channel floor(v x 0.5)).

fields.name: shade_6
fields.description: Shade 6: the color mixed 60% toward black (each channel floor(v x 0.4)).

fields.name: shade_7
fields.description: Shade 7: the color mixed 70% toward black (each channel floor(v x 0.3)).

fields.name: shade_8
fields.description: Shade 8: the color mixed 80% toward black (each channel floor(v x 0.2)).

fields.name: shade_9
fields.description: Shade 9: the color mixed 90% toward black (each channel floor(v x 0.1)).

fields.name: tint_1
fields.description: Tint 1: the color mixed 10% toward white (each channel floor(v x 0.9 + 255 x 0.1)).

fields.name: tint_2
fields.description: Tint 2: the color mixed 20% toward white (each channel floor(v x 0.8 + 255 x 0.2)).

fields.name: tint_3
fields.description: Tint 3: the color mixed 30% toward white (each channel floor(v x 0.7 + 255 x 0.3)).

fields.name: tint_4
fields.description: Tint 4: the color mixed 40% toward white (each channel floor(v x 0.6 + 255 x 0.4)).

fields.name: tint_5
fields.description: Tint 5: the color mixed 50% toward white (each channel floor(v x 0.5 + 255 x 0.5)).

fields.name: tint_6
fields.description: Tint 6: the color mixed 60% toward white (each channel floor(v x 0.4 + 255 x 0.6)).

fields.name: tint_7
fields.description: Tint 7: the color mixed 70% toward white (each channel floor(v x 0.3 + 255 x 0.7)).

fields.name: tint_8
fields.description: Tint 8: the color mixed 80% toward white (each channel floor(v x 0.2 + 255 x 0.8)).

fields.name: tint_9
fields.description: Tint 9: the color mixed 90% toward white (each channel floor(v x 0.1 + 255 x 0.9)).

fields.name: monochromatic_1
fields.description: Same HSL hue and saturation, lightness -15 points.

fields.name: monochromatic_2
fields.description: Same HSL hue and saturation, lightness -10 points.

fields.name: monochromatic_3
fields.description: Same HSL hue and saturation, lightness -5 points.

fields.name: monochromatic_4
fields.description: Same HSL hue and saturation, lightness +5 points.

fields.name: monochromatic_5
fields.description: Same HSL hue and saturation, lightness +10 points.

fields.name: monochromatic_6
fields.description: Same HSL hue and saturation, lightness +15 points.

fields.name: palette_1_1
fields.description: Complementary palette color 1: the base color.

fields.name: palette_1_2
fields.description: Complementary palette color 2: a light version (HSL lightness 55% of the way to white).

fields.name: palette_1_3
fields.description: Complementary palette color 3: a dark version (HSL lightness reduced by 45%).

fields.name: palette_1_4
fields.description: Complementary palette color 4: the complement (each channel max + min - value).

fields.name: palette_1_5
fields.description: Complementary palette color 5: a light complement (55% of the way to white).

fields.name: palette_6_1
fields.description: Neutral pairing palette color 1: the base color.

fields.name: palette_6_2
fields.description: Neutral pairing palette color 2: an off-white tinted toward its hue (HSL lightness 96%, saturation x 0.20).

fields.name: palette_6_3
fields.description: Neutral pairing palette color 3: a light gray (lightness 82%, saturation x 0.12).

fields.name: palette_6_4
fields.description: Neutral pairing palette color 4: a slate (lightness 45%, saturation x 0.15).

fields.name: palette_6_5
fields.description: Neutral pairing palette color 5: a charcoal (lightness 15%, saturation x 0.25).

resources.name: color_relationships
resources.title: Color relationships
resources.description: One row per color and related color: 9 shades, 9 tints and the 5-color Complementary and Neutral pairing palettes (28 rows per color), in long form for charts and tables.

fields.name: color_id
fields.description: The color the row belongs to; joins colors.color_id.

fields.name: relation
fields.description: Which relation: shade, tint, palette_1 (Complementary palette) or palette_6 (Neutral pairing palette).

fields.name: position
fields.description: Position in the relation: 1-9 for shades and tints (10% steps), 1-5 for palettes; matches the column suffix in colors.csv (shade_3 = relation shade, position 3).

fields.name: related_hex
fields.description: The related color, #rrggbb lowercase; same value as the matching column in colors.csv.

fields.name: related_color_id
fields.description: color_id of the named color with exactly this hex; blank when the related color has no name (most shades and tints).

fields.name: related_swatch
fields.description: Nearest of 4,096 stand-in colors (each channel rounded to a multiple of 17; at most 8/255 off), so related colors can be colored with a 4,096-color palette.

fields.name: related_text
fields.description: White or Black, whichever reads better on related_hex (WCAG contrast).

resources.name: color_galaxy
resources.title: Chart layouts
resources.description: One row per color: X/Y positions for the galaxy and Milky Way charts and box positions for the color picker, each for all colors and for each of the four color sets.

fields.name: color_id
fields.description: The color; joins colors.color_id (one row per color).

fields.name: color_set
fields.description: The color's set: ROY (shade_group Red, Orange, Yellow), GCB (Green, Cyan, Blue), PP (Purple, Pink) or WGB (White, Gray, Black). Blank for Brown, which belongs to no set and appears only in the all-colors views.

fields.name: galaxy_all_part
fields.description: Part of the all-colors galaxy: Core (White), Haze (Gray, Black) or Arm (every other group).

fields.name: galaxy_all_x
fields.description: X of the all-colors spiral galaxy, chart units 0-160 (center 80). Nine arms 40 degrees apart in color-wheel order (Pink, Red, Orange, Brown, Yellow, Green, Cyan, Blue, Purple); lighter colors sit nearer the center; browns are placed by lightness rank so their arm runs from tans at the core to dark browns at the rim; muted colors spread wider than vivid ones. Small offsets come from a fixed hash of color_id, so positions never change between builds.

fields.name: galaxy_all_y
fields.description: Y of the all-colors galaxy, chart units 0-90 (center 45).

fields.name: galaxy_roy_x
fields.description: X in the Red-Orange-Yellow galaxy, 0-160; blank for colors outside the set. A spiral with a small core of the set's lightest colors and arms that run light (center) to dark (rim).

fields.name: galaxy_roy_y
fields.description: Y in the Red-Orange-Yellow galaxy, 0-90; blank outside the set.

fields.name: galaxy_gcb_x
fields.description: X in the Green-Cyan-Blue galaxy, 0-160; blank for colors outside the set. A spiral with a small core of the set's lightest colors and arms that run light (center) to dark (rim).

fields.name: galaxy_gcb_y
fields.description: Y in the Green-Cyan-Blue galaxy, 0-90; blank outside the set.

fields.name: galaxy_pp_x
fields.description: X in the Purple-Pink galaxy, 0-160; blank for colors outside the set. A spiral with a small core of the set's lightest colors and arms that run light (center) to dark (rim).

fields.name: galaxy_pp_y
fields.description: Y in the Purple-Pink galaxy, 0-90; blank outside the set.

fields.name: galaxy_wgb_x
fields.description: X in the White-Gray-Black galaxy, 0-160; blank for colors outside the set. A spiral with a small core of the set's lightest colors and arms that run light (center) to dark (rim).

fields.name: galaxy_wgb_y
fields.description: Y in the White-Gray-Black galaxy, 0-90; blank outside the set.

fields.name: galaxy_set_part
fields.description: Part of the color in its own set's galaxy: Core (the set's lightest 6%) or Arm. Blank for Brown.

fields.name: galaxy_set_arm
fields.description: Arm number 1-6 in the set's galaxy (blank for the core and for Brown). ROY and GCB have 6 arms (each color group twice, alternating), PP 4, WGB 6 (split by tint).

fields.name: mw_all_part
fields.description: Star (chroma under 8, scattered over the sky) or Ribbon.

fields.name: mw_all_x
fields.description: X of the all-colors Milky Way, chart units 0-160: a twisting ribbon from lower left to upper right, hue along it (30 degrees at its widest point), lightness across 19 lanes.

fields.name: mw_all_y
fields.description: Y of the all-colors Milky Way, chart units 0-90.

fields.name: mw_all_order
fields.description: Draw order 1-31,996: stars first, then ribbon colors dark to light.

fields.name: mw_roy_x
fields.description: X in the Red-Orange-Yellow Milky Way, 0-160; blank outside the set. The set's own ribbon: hue along it, lightness across its lanes.

fields.name: mw_roy_y
fields.description: Y in the Red-Orange-Yellow Milky Way, 0-90; blank outside the set.

fields.name: mw_gcb_x
fields.description: X in the Green-Cyan-Blue Milky Way, 0-160; blank outside the set. The set's own ribbon: hue along it, lightness across its lanes.

fields.name: mw_gcb_y
fields.description: Y in the Green-Cyan-Blue Milky Way, 0-90; blank outside the set.

fields.name: mw_pp_x
fields.description: X in the Purple-Pink Milky Way, 0-160; blank outside the set. The set's own ribbon: hue along it, lightness across its lanes.

fields.name: mw_pp_y
fields.description: Y in the Purple-Pink Milky Way, 0-90; blank outside the set.

fields.name: mw_wgb_x
fields.description: X in the White-Gray-Black Milky Way, 0-160; blank outside the set. The set's own ribbon: hue along it, lightness across its lanes.

fields.name: mw_wgb_y
fields.description: Y in the White-Gray-Black Milky Way, 0-90; blank outside the set.

fields.name: mw_set_part
fields.description: Star (the set's most muted 16.5%) or Ribbon in its set's Milky Way. Blank for Brown.

fields.name: mw_set_order
fields.description: Draw order 1-25,037 across set members: stars first, then dark to light. Blank for Brown.

fields.description: Box row 1-30 in the Green-Cyan-Blue picker, white (1) to full color (30); blank outside the set.

fields.description: Box row 1-30 in the Purple-Pink picker, white (1) to full color (30); blank outside the set.
